title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30331: add event to adjust corrective credit memo confirmation text
summary: An integration event has been added before the corrective credit memo confirmation dialog, allowing extensions to adjust the confirmation text when a posted sales invoice is being corrected.
key_points: New integration event `OnCreateCreditMemoCopyDocumentOnBeforeConfirm` fires before the confirmation dialog appears
Event exposes the posted invoice, originating sales order, and modifiable confirmation text
Enables extensions to customize confirmation text to reflect their own behavior changes
Change applied across W1, APAC, and ES layers
